subject: ela
intro: Pick the relevant detail or strong presentation choice.

items.prompt:
In a report on renewable energy, which detail belongs?
A) Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity
B) My favorite show is on tonight
C) I lost my pencil
items.answer: A) Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity

solution.answer: A) Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity

items.prompt:
When presenting, you should speak:
A) clearly, at an understandable pace
B) in a whisper
C) as fast as you can
items.answer: A) clearly, at an understandable pace

steps: Clear and paced. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) clearly, at an understandable pace

items.prompt:
Ideas in a report should be:
A) sequenced logically
B) in random order
C) hidden

Which detail does NOT belong in a report on the ocean?
A) The ocean covers most of Earth.
B) Many animals live in the ocean.
C) I like video games.

Main ideas in a report should be supported by:
A) relevant facts and details
B) random unrelated facts
C) nothing

To help the audience follow your report, organize ideas:
A) logically
B) randomly
C) backward

Which is the BEST opening for a report presenting an OPINION about school lunches?
A) I believe our school should offer more fresh fruit, and here are three reasons.
B) Um, I'm not sure.
C) My weekend was fun.
items.answer: A) I believe our school should offer more fresh fruit, and here are three reasons.

steps: States opinion and previews reasons. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) I believe our school should offer more fresh fruit, and here are three reasons.

items.prompt:
A strong spoken report has:
A) a clear logical order, relevant facts and details, and a clear voice
B) jumps between unrelated ideas
C) mumbling the whole time
items.answer: A) a clear logical order, relevant facts and details, and a clear voice

steps: Organized, supported, clear. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a clear logical order, relevant facts and details, and a clear voice
